summary: Explore our comprehensive training programs for NGOs focused on achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Empower your organization for impactful change.
lede: Sustainable development training helps NGO professionals plan, monitor, and report programmes against the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It is designed for programme managers, monitoring and evaluation staff, grant writers, and project coordinators who need to provide useful evidence to partners and funders. Participants practise mapping programmes to SDG targets, building results frameworks, checking data quality, and preparing dashboards and reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to connect NGO delivery, evidence collection, and SDG reporting in a practical way. NGO Programme Managers coordinating SDG-linked delivery. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Officers tracking results and indicators. Grant Writers preparing SDG-aligned funding proposals. Partnership Managers aligning donor expectations with programme evidence. NGO Directors reporting contribution to leadership and boards. MEAL Specialists designing data collection and verification workflows. Project Coordinators maintaining field reporting and activity logs. Advocacy Officers translating programme evidence into policy messages. Donor Relations Officers handling SDG-aligned reporting packs. Impact and Research Officers analysing outcome data and dashboards.
prerequisites: You need basic familiarity with NGO programme structures, results reporting, and Microsoft Excel or a similar spreadsheet tool. A laptop is recommended for exercises, and if your organisation already uses KoboToolbox or Power BI, you can bring those workflows into the workshops.
